              "markdown": "The Hebrew letter **Nun** (נ) is the [14th Hebrew letter](https://www.hebrew4christians.com/Grammar/Unit_One/Aleph-Bet/Nun/nun.html) of the Hebrew alphabet with a numerical value of **50**.[[1]](https://www.hebrew4christians.com/Grammar/Unit_One/Aleph-Bet/Nun/nun.html)\n\n### Key Facts\n\n- **Sound:** Makes the \"n\" sound, like in the word \"noon\".[[1]](https://www.facebook.com/100068612731591/posts/how-to-write-the-hebrew-letter-nun-in-blockscriptnun-%D7%A0-final-nun-%D7%9F-alphabetical-/851145567182527/)\n- **Numerical Value (Gematria):** 50, which connects to the 50 gates of understanding ([Binah](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/137086/jewish/Nun.htm) ) and the 50th year of the [Jubilee](https://deforest.london/2020/07/14/the-illuminating-meaning-of-the-hebrew-letter-nun/).[[1]](https://www.hebrew4christians.com/Grammar/Unit_One/Aleph-Bet/Nun/nun.html)[[2]](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/137086/jewish/Nun.htm)[[3]](https://deforest.london/2020/07/14/the-illuminating-meaning-of-the-hebrew-letter-nun/)\n- **Two Forms:** \n\t- **Medial/Initial Nun (נ):** Bent or curved shape used at the beginning or middle of a word, representing humility and a bent posture.\n\t- **Final Nun / Nun Sofit (ן):** Straight shape used strictly at the end of a word, representing a vertical stance or redemption.[[1]](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/137086/jewish/Nun.htm)\n- **Ancient Meaning:** In early pictographic Hebrew, it symbolized a sprouting seed, continuity, an heir, or a fish (representing life and productiveness in Aramaic).[[1]](https://deforest.london/2020/07/14/the-illuminating-meaning-of-the-hebrew-letter-nun/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zWRFof-J3Zg&t=1)[[3]](https://www.ancient-hebrew.org/ancient-alphabet/nun.htm)\n\nWould you like to know more about the **gematria**, **symbolism** , or **words** that start with the letter Nun?",
